# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
Only the latest master/main branch deployments of the LitePing Engine receive security updates and performance patches.

## Reporting a Vulnerability
Do not open a public GitHub issue if you discover a security flaw or an optimization leak in our tracking loops. Please report all vulnerabilities privately by sending an email detailing your reproduction steps to rohithroy1607@gmail.com. 

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and coordinate a public security patch release cleanly.
